goal: Implement only the I57-authorized minimal CP-07T entry-field create flow with stable parent identity, seven safe FieldTypes, exactly one adapter write, read-port refresh and deterministic focus

guide_delta.topic: Feld direkt am ausgewählten Eintrag anlegen
guide_delta.summary: Die TUI kann jetzt ein einfaches Feld anlegen: Eintrag auswählen, F drücken, einen von sieben sicheren Feldtypen wählen, Namen eingeben und mit Enter bestätigen. Geld- und Auswahlfelder bleiben bewusst gesperrt.

tests_required: field create unavailable without injected writer
MONEY and choice types not exposed
entry_id captured at create start and remains stable
exactly one field write on submit
success does not reload categories or entries
success restores captured entry identity and focuses field list
error performs no refresh and keeps parent/type/input focus
escape from type or name step performs no write and clears transient state
runtime remains free of SQL/storage imports
Manifest V2 and strict scope validation
tests_explicitly_not_run: full product suite because the reopen is limited to CP-07T field create
browser tests because web code is untouched
database/domain/repository regressions because frozen core is untouched
200 percent/manual accessibility evidence because that is reserved for I60
risks: the new transient type selector increases runtime focus states and therefore requires targeted keyboard regression
FieldType labels are intentionally local in I58 and may be centralized only in I59 after this flow is frozen
MONEY, SINGLE_CHOICE and MULTI_CHOICE must remain unreachable from the new create surface
expected_side_effects: pressing f on a selected entry opens a keyboard-only seven-type selector
successful creation reloads only the selected entry field rows through TuiDataPort
read-only construction without field_writer remains supported
